pages.title: Control Theory
pages.text: $(thing)Control Theory$()$(br2)Feed back too hard and a machine overshoots and rings; too gently and it drifts. Maxwell worked out where the line is. Unlocks the Governor.

$(thing)Insight$(): 100$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Feedback, Optimisation.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Stability Margin, 2 Euclidean Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A controller corrects an error e by a gain k each second. Write how much error E is left after t seconds of smooth correction.
